parks.name: Edwin B. Forsythe National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Salt marsh near Atlantic City; shorebirds, snow geese, ospreys and terrapins.

parks.name: Cape May Point State Park
parks.blurb: Southern tip of the state; migrating hawks, monarchs, shorebirds and horseshoe crabs.

parks.name: Great Swamp National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Swamp forest near New York; turtles, wood ducks, owls and deer.

parks.name: Delaware Water Gap National Recreation Area
parks.blurb: River gorge and ridges; black bears, bald eagles, deer and trout.

parks.name: Sandy Hook
parks.blurb: Beach peninsula; seals, ospreys, piping plovers and holly forest birds.

parks.name: High Point State Park
parks.blurb: Highest point in the state; hawks, black bears, deer and turtles.

parks.name: Island Beach State Park
parks.blurb: Barrier island; ospreys, foxes, seals and shorebirds.

parks.name: Wharton State Forest
parks.blurb: Pine Barrens; pine snakes, tree frogs, owls and white-tailed deer.

parks.name: Liberty State Park
parks.blurb: Harbor park by New York City; herons, egrets, ospreys and gulls.

parks.name: Hackensack Meadowlands DeKorte Park
parks.blurb: Marsh near New York City; egrets, herons, ospreys and ducks.
